record_title: Sharp fiber-extreme barriers for sparse Bernoulli tensor norms
limitations: Homogeneous independent Bernoulli tensors only. The exact second-order center is stated for d=c log n; the one-mode lattice law does not assert cross-mode independence, and the result gives a lower obstruction rather than the full tensor-norm limiting constant. Classical discrete-extreme theory may cover the scalar maximum calculation; the full Anderson-Coles-Husler (1997) article was not directly inspected. Independent audit has not been performed.
